# vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp

## Overview

[`vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp) implements three root-level groups: `copy`, `single_plane_copy`, and `copy_dimensions`, returned by [`createCopyTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L1023-L1026), [`createSinglePlanarCopyTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L1028-L1031), and [`createDimensionsCopyTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L1033-L1036). The main test path creates source and destination images, performs direct `vkCmdCopyImage` or buffer-mediated copies, downloads the result, and compares byte-level data in [`imageCopyTest()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L477-L755).

The three roots appear in one parseable tree block because this source file registers three root-level YCbCr groups.

## Test Families

### copy

Default copy tests iterate `formats::basicUnsignedFloatFormats` for source and destination, keep only pairs where at least one side is YCbCr and the pair is copy-compatible, then generate optimal/linear source and destination tiling, source/destination disjoint states, and direct or intermediate-buffer copy variants in [`initYcbcrDefaultCopyTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L816-L858). Copy compatibility is determined by compatible plane formats in [`isCopyCompatible()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L758-L790), and random compatible plane-copy regions are generated by [`genCopies()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L346-L360).

### single_plane_copy

Single-planar copy tests use two explicit pairs, `R8G8B8A8_UNORM -> G8B8G8R8_422_UNORM` with a `32x64` extent and `G8B8G8R8_422_UNORM -> R8G8B8A8_UNORM` with a `64x64` extent, across optimal and linear tiling combinations in [`initYcbcrSinglePlanarCopyTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L874-L915).

### copy_dimensions

Dimension-stress tests use four 4:2:0 YCbCr formats at 8/10/12/16 bits plus `VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM`, and sixteen wide/tall dimensions from `4096x4` through `6x32768`, then generate copy-compatible pairs, tiling combinations, and disjoint states in [`initYcbcrDimensionsCopyTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L927-L1006).

## Parameters

| Dimension | Source-backed values |
|---|---|
| Copy count | Default copy cases generate ten random copy regions when no fixed extent is supplied in [`imageCopyTest()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L489-L502). |
| Intermediate buffer | Buffer-mediated copy variants use `vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer` followed by `vkCmdCopyBufferToImage`; direct variants use `vkCmdCopyImage` in [`imageCopyTest()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L587-L630). |
| Disjoint | Default and dimension groups vary source and destination disjoint states in [`initYcbcrDefaultCopyTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L843-L858) and [`initYcbcrDimensionsCopyTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L995-L1006). |
| Image limits | Requested source and destination dimensions are checked against `maxImageDimension2D` in [`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L175-L183). |

## Support Requirements

[`checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L175-L190) checks image-dimension limits, requires `VK_KHR_sampler_ycbcr_conversion`, and requires the `samplerYcbcrConversion` feature. Format-level support checks require transfer source/destination capability and disjoint support when requested in the helper just above `checkSupport()` at [`vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L164-L170).

## Verification Method

[`imageCopyTest()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L477-L755) fills source and destination image data, executes the copy commands, downloads or reads destination memory, constructs a reference by applying the same plane/block copies to the original destination data, masks don't-care low bits for affected packed formats, logs up to 30 byte-level mismatches, and returns pass only when no mismatches remain.

## Notes / Uncertainties

The default copy source uses `UVec2(24,16)` for YCbCr formats and `UVec2(23,17)` for non-YCbCr formats in [`initYcbcrDefaultCopyTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/ycbcr/vktYCbCrCopyTests.cpp#L816-L824); the larger dimensions are specific to `copy_dimensions`.
